title: Utah prosecutors drop criminal charges against Kalshi and its co-founders, one day after the company halted operations in the state (Marshall Cohen/CNN)
summary: Marshall Cohen / CNN: Utah prosecutors drop criminal charges against Kalshi and its co-founders, one day after the company halted operations in the state — Utah prosecutors dropped criminal charges against the prediction company Kalshi and its co-founders on Tuesday, one day after the company halted operations in the state.
